CommunityApplications.Profile:
Blizzbeat is a self-hosted Discord music bot (a Nightbot replacement) with Lavalink built in, packaged as one container.
What you get: - Its own channel with an animated banner and one live player (now playing, progress, Up Next, buttons) that is edited in place, never spammed. - Type a song name or link, or drop an audio file, to play it. Slash commands for everything else (/play, /queue, /favourites, /config...). - YouTube (Lavalink plugin or yt-dlp), Spotify, SoundCloud, Bandcamp, Twitch and anything yt-dlp supports, with original-quality Opus passthrough. - Autoplay with moods, favourites, vote-skip, audio effects, live-stream auto-reconnect, Stage channel support and voice-only channel access. - Lavalink, its plugins and yt-dlp update themselves on launch and daily.
Only a Discord bot token is required. Setup guide, configuration and troubleshooting are in the README on GitHub. For help or bug reports, open an issue on GitHub.
